introduction:
Introduction About AVVA SR CAPSULE

AVVA SR CAPSULE contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with AVVA SR CAPSULE is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as AVVA SR CAPSULE may interfere with these tests.

Before taking AVVA SR CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

AVVA SR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of AVVA SR CAPSULE will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like AVVA SR CAPSULE have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking AVVA SR CAPSULE are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How AVVA SR CAPSULE Works

AVVA SR CAPSULE effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. AVVA SR CAPSULE also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.
usageDetails:
How to use AVVA SR CAPSULE

Take AVVA SR CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: ENDOR Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About ENDOR EYE DROPS

ENDOR EYE DROPS contains Dorzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthamic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage glaucoma. Glaucoma is group of eye condition that damages the optic nerve (nerves which are responsible for proper vision). It is characterized by increased pressure within the eyes caused due to impaired secretion or drainage of fluids (aqueous humour) within the eyes.

ENDOR EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying ENDOR EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using ENDOR EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use ENDOR EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using ENDOR EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, sore eyes, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.
uses: Manage glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ENDOR EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye)
mechanismOfAction:
How ENDOR EYE DROPS Works

ENDOR EYE DROPS reduces pressure within the eye. It works by blocking the action of an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase within the eye, that causes the pressure within the eye to raise. As a result, it decreases the elevated pressure within the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of glaucoma (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use ENDOR EYE DROPS

Use ENDOR EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying ENDOR EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying ENDOR EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using ENDOR EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

name: Bidin LS TM Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS

BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS Works

BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS

Use BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BIDIN LS TM EYE DROPS for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

Have diabetes

introduction:
Introduction About MISOPT EYE DROPS

MISOPT EYE DROPS is a combination of Dorzolamide and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage increased pressure in the eye caused due to glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with beta-blockers (Ex. timolol) alone.

MISOPT EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil a few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surfaces to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying MISOPT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using MISOPT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or previously had any breathing problems, asthma, COPD, diabetes, thyroid problems, Raynaud’s disease or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use MISOPT EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using MISOPT EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, eye redness and itching, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MISOPT EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma/ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How MISOPT EYE DROPS Works

MISOPT EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of ocular hypertension (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use MISOPT EYE DROPS

Use MISOPT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying MISOPT EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying MISOPT EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using MISOPT EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About IOPAR SR CAPSULE

IOPAR SR CAPSULE contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with IOPAR SR CAPSULE is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as IOPAR SR CAPSULE may interfere with these tests.

Before taking IOPAR SR CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

IOPAR SR CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of IOPAR SR CAPSULE will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like IOPAR SR CAPSULE have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking IOPAR SR CAPSULE are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How IOPAR SR CAPSULE Works

IOPAR SR CAPSULE effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. IOPAR SR CAPSULE also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.

Take IOPAR SR CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS

LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Travoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS is indicated to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues.  

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

Before using LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any respiratory or heart disease. If you wear soft contact lenses, apply LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS at least 15 minutes before you wear your lens.

Do not use this medicine directly on your eyes while wearing your contact lenses in. If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, avoid direct exposure of LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS. If any of the medicine encounters with your skin, immediately wash it off with soap and water.  

LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers, children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of using LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS are eye redness, pain, itching and eye dryness or discomfort.

It can also lead to a permanent change in the color of the iris or increase the length, thickness, color and/or number of your eyelashes. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

LUPITROS TZ EYE DROPS effectively reduces elevated pressure in the eye, where timolol acts by decreasing the production of fluid in the eye (aqueous humor) and travoprost acts by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor from the eye. Collectively they decrease the elevated pressure within the eye.

It is used to manage increased pressure in the eye caused due to glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with beta-blockers (Ex. timolol) alone.

CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil a few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surfaces to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or previously had any breathing problems, asthma, COPD, diabetes, thyroid problems, Raynaud’s disease or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, eye redness and itching, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.

Manage glaucoma/ocular hypertension

How CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS Works

CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye. Apply applying CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using CIAZ DUO EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

Before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any respiratory or heart disease. If you wear soft contact lenses, apply TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS at least 15 minutes before you wear your lens.

Do not use this medicine directly on your eyes while wearing your contact lenses in. If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, avoid direct exposure of TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS. If any of the medicine encounters with your skin, immediately wash it off with soap and water.  

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers, children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS are eye redness, pain, itching and eye dryness or discomfort.

It can also lead to a permanent change in the color of the iris or increase the length, thickness, color and/or number of your eyelashes. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

How TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS Works

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS effectively reduces elevated pressure in the eye, where timolol acts by decreasing the production of fluid in the eye (aqueous humor) and travoprost acts by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor from the eye. Collectively they decrease the elevated pressure within the eye.

usageDetails:
How to use TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS

Use TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Instill the prescribed amount of the medicine into your eye(s). Follow the following steps while using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS: 

Wash your hands thoroughly before application
Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull down your lower eyelid
Gently squeeze the bottle and instill the medicine drop wise into your eye
Close your eyes and gently press the corner of your eye with a finger for 2 minutes to avoid leakage of the medicine from your eye
If necessary, repeat the same steps for the other eye
Close the bottle and wash your hands

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your fingertips, eyelids or other parts of the eye surface to avoid the risk of contamination. Do not use TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS for more than 4 weeks after opening it to manage infections. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Continue to use TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS, if your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. Women of child-bearing potential should use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid getting pregnant while using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.

Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness, hallucination, nervousness or fatigue after using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.
Do not use TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS if you are allergic to Timolol, Travoprost or other beta-blockers (Ex. betaxolol, levobunolol) or prostaglandin analogs (Ex. latanoprost, bimatoprost).

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who have or had any respiratory problems (such as asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis or other breathing problems) in the past. Consult your doctor before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as heart failure or irregular heartbeat). It should be used with caution among patients who have or had other heart problems such as coronary heart disease or low blood pressure in the past. Consult your doctor before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.

Others

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is not recommended for you, if you have:

Severe hay fever (an allergic reaction causing itchy eyes, runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing and sinus pressure)
Cloudy eyes

Before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have:

Blood circulation disorders (such as Raynaud’s disease or Raynaud’s syndrome)
Diabetes
Overactivity of the thyroid gland
Myasthenia gravis (long-term neuromuscular weakness)
Cataract surgery or any upcoming surgery
An eye inflammation

Use in pediatrics:

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your doctor before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.

Use in geriatrics:

TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, consult your doctor before using TRAVISIGHT T EYE DROPS.

introduction:
Introduction About TRAVSTAR PF EYE DROPS

TRAVSTAR PF EYE DROPS contains Travoprost, which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogues. It is indicated in the management of elevated intraocular pressure in patients with ocular hypertension or open-angle glaucoma.

Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to your optic nerve (the nerve that carries visual messages) that may result in loss of vision. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure in your eyes is more than the normal range, with no distinguishable changes in vision or damage to the structure of your eyes.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using TRAVSTAR PF EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease, eye inflammation, had cataract surgery, or wear soft contact lenses.

TRAVSTAR PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. TRAVSTAR PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children younger than 2 months of age, therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects are eye redness, pain, discomfort, irritation, changes in the colour of the eye, and dry or itchy eyes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

SYNCA EYE DROP is a combination of Brimonidine and Brinzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used in adults to manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes). It is typically used in patients who are not responding well to therapy with single agents.

SYNCA EYE DROP is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of this medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before using SYNCA EYE DROP and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using SYNCA EYE DROP inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low or high blood pressure, narrow-angle glaucoma, dry eyes, depression or poor blood circulation in your body as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before using SYNCA EYE DROP if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using SYNCA EYE DROP are eye pain, redness, discomfort, irritation, itching or inflammation, blurred vision and bad taste. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SYNCA EYE DROP
Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SYNCA EYE DROP Works

SYNCA EYE DROP works by decreasing the production of excessive eye fluids (aqueous humour) while simultaneously increasing their drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use SYNCA EYE DROP

Use SYNCA EYE DROP as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of SYNCA EYE DROP into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying SYNCA EYE DROP, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying SYNCA EYE DROP and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using SYNCA EYE DROP without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

warnings.details: SYNCA EYE DROP is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Women of childbearing age should use proper contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with SYNCA EYE DROP.
SYNCA EYE DROP is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, drowsiness or tiredness after using SYNCA EYE DROP.
Avoid the consumption of alcohol while using SYNCA EYE DROP as it may increase the risk of side effects.
SYNCA EYE DROP is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
SYNCA EYE DROP should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
Talk to your doctor if you are allergic to Brimonidine, Brinzolamide, sulphonamides (such as glipizide, gliclazide) or diuretics (such as furosemide).
SYNCA EYE DROP should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as coronary heart disease or heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

SYNCA EYE DROP is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperchloremic acidosis (a condition where there is too much of acidity in blood)

Before using SYNCA EYE DROP, inform your doctor if you:

Have dry eyes or problems in your cornea
Have narrow angle glaucoma (a type of rapid increase in pressure within the eye)
Have high or low blood pressure
Have depression
Have poor blood circulation in the body (such as Raynaud’s disease)
Have reduced blood supply to the brain or reduced mental capacity
Wear soft contact lenses

Use in pediatrics:

SYNCA EYE DROP is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Use in geriatrics:

SYNCA EYE DROP should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before using SYNCA EYE DROP, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Medicines used to manage depression such as (Ex. citalopram, escitalopram, fluoxetine, sertraline, amitriptyline, nortriptyline, moclobemide, selegiline, phenelzine, isocarboxazid, clomipramine, mianserin, venlafaxine and duloxetine)
Medicines used to induce sleep (Ex. alprazolam, midazolam, phenobarbital)
Medicines used to manage mental illness (Ex. chlorpromazine, methylphenidate, reserpine)
Medicines used to lower blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, ramipril)
Digoxin (a medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Anaesthetics (used to induce numbness) Ex. lidocaine
Other carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (used to manage glaucoma) Ex. acetazolamide and dorzolamide
Medicines used to manage viral infections (such as ritonavir, nelfinavir, atazanavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (such as ketoconazole, fluconazole, itraconazole)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (such as amoxicillin, cefixime, azithromycin, clarithromycin)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally used more SYNCA EYE DROP, rinse your eye with warm water. If still irritation persists, consult your doctor.

If you or anyone else accidentally swallowed this medicine, contact your doctor immediately. Symptoms of overdose might include slow heartbeat, low or high blood pressure, difficulty in breathing and confusion or nerve problems.

name: DUPRESS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DUPRESS TABLET

DUPRESS TABLET contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with DUPRESS TABLET is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as DUPRESS TABLET may interfere with these tests.

Before taking DUPRESS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

DUPRESS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of DUPRESS TABLET will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like DUPRESS TABLET have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking DUPRESS TABLET are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Abnormal fluid retention in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUPRESS TABLET

Manages

Glaucoma
Abnormal fluid retention in the body
Epilepsy
mechanismOfAction:
How DUPRESS TABLET Works

DUPRESS TABLET effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. DUPRESS TABLET also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.
usageDetails:
How to use DUPRESS TABLET

Take DUPRESS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

DUPRESS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

DUPRESS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have or had chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma (blurred vision, eye pain, halos around lights)
Have reduced function of adrenal glands
Have hypokalaemia (low potassium levels in the blood)
Have hyponatremia (low sodium levels in the blood)
Have hyperchloremia (high levels of chlorine in the blood)

name: Ganfort Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About GANFORT EYE DROPS

GANFORT EYE DROPS is a combination of Bimatoprost and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs and Beta-blockers respectively. It is used to manage glaucoma and ocular hypertension.

Glaucoma is an eye condition that can cause vision loss and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of your eye called the optic nerve. Ocular hypertension is an elevated pressure within the eye without damage to any optic nerve and vision loss or blindness.

Before using GANFORT EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have heart disease, liver disease, kidney disease or any other problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before using GANFORT EYE DROPS. Inform your doctor if you wear contact lenses before using GANFORT EYE DROPS.

The most common side effects of using GANFORT EYE DROPS are eye redness, burning, itching, stinging, irritation of the conjunctiva, eye pain, dry eye, eye irritation, watery eyes, swollen eyelids, and reduced vision. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GANFORT EYE DROPS

It is used to manage:

Glaucoma
Ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How GANFORT EYE DROPS Works

GANFORT EYE DROPS works together by reducing the production of liquid and also increasing the amount of liquid that is drained. This reduces the pressure inside the eye.
usageDetails:
How to use GANFORT EYE DROPS

Use GANFORT EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: GANFORT EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using it.
GANFORT EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before using it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel blurred vision, dizziness, eyesight problem, after using GANFORT EYE DROPS.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with GANFORT EYE DROPS.
GANFORT EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before using.
GANFORT EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before using.
Do not use this medicine if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Bimatoprost or Timolol or beta-blockers or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

GANFORT EYE DROPS is not recommended in patients with respiratory problems such as asthma, severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (lung disease which may cause wheeziness, difficulty in breathing and/or long-standing cough) or other types of breathing problems.

GANFORT EYE DROPS is not recommended in patients with heart problems such as low heart rate, heart block, or heart failure. It must be used with caution in patients with coronary heart disease (symptoms can include chest pain or tightness, breathlessness or choking) and lower blood pressure. Consult your doctor before using.

Others

Before using GANFORT EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have:

Poor blood circulation disease  
Overactivity of the thyroid gland  
Diabetes  
Eye surface problems
Separation of one of the layers within the eyeball after surgery to reduce the pressure in the eye
Severe allergic reactions
Macular oedema (swelling of the retina within the eye leading to worsening vision)
Other eye disorder
An operation, including minor surgery and dental work

Use in pediatrics:

GANFORT EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before using GANFORT EYE DROPS.

Use in geriatrics:

GANFORT EYE DROPS should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before using GANFORT EYE DROPS.

name: PRESS DT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PRESS DT TABLET

PRESS DT TABLET contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with PRESS DT TABLET is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as PRESS DT TABLET may interfere with these tests.

Before taking PRESS DT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

PRESS DT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of PRESS DT TABLET will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like PRESS DT TABLET have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking PRESS DT TABLET are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Abnormal fluid retention in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of PRESS DT TABLET

Manages

Glaucoma
Abnormal fluid retention in the body
Epilepsy
mechanismOfAction:
How PRESS DT TABLET Works

PRESS DT TABLET effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. PRESS DT TABLET also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.
usageDetails:
How to use PRESS DT TABLET

Take PRESS DT TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: DUO 2 Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About DUO 2 EYE DROPS

DUO 2 EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Brinzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used in adults to manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes). It is typically used in patients who are not responding well to therapy with single agents.

DUO 2 EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of this medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before using DUO 2 EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using DUO 2 EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low or high blood pressure, narrow-angle glaucoma, dry eyes, depression or poor blood circulation in your body as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before using DUO 2 EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using DUO 2 EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, discomfort, irritation, itching or inflammation, blurred vision and bad taste. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of DUO 2 EYE DROPS
Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How DUO 2 EYE DROPS Works

DUO 2 EYE DROPS works by decreasing the production of excessive eye fluids (aqueous humour) while simultaneously increasing their drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use DUO 2 EYE DROPS

Use DUO 2 EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of DUO 2 EYE DROPS into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying DUO 2 EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DUO 2 EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using DUO 2 EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About T 1 Z EYE DROPS

T 1 Z EYE DROPS contains Travoprost, which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogues. It is indicated in the management of elevated intraocular pressure in patients with ocular hypertension or open-angle glaucoma.

Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to your optic nerve (the nerve that carries visual messages) that may result in loss of vision. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure in your eyes is more than the normal range, with no distinguishable changes in vision or damage to the structure of your eyes.

Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using T 1 Z EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease, eye inflammation, had cataract surgery, or wear soft contact lenses.

T 1 Z EYE DROPS is not recommended for use by pregnant and breastfeeding women. T 1 Z EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children younger than 2 months of age, therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

The most common side effects are eye redness, pain, discomfort, irritation, changes in the colour of the eye, and dry or itchy eyes. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About BIMAT T EYE DROPS

BIMAT T EYE DROPS is a combination of Bimatoprost and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs and Beta-blockers respectively. It is used to manage glaucoma and ocular hypertension.

Glaucoma is an eye condition that can cause vision loss and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of your eye called the optic nerve. Ocular hypertension is an elevated pressure within the eye without damage to any optic nerve and vision loss or blindness.

Before using BIMAT T EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have heart disease, liver disease, kidney disease or any other problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before using BIMAT T EYE DROPS. Inform your doctor if you wear contact lenses before using BIMAT T EYE DROPS.

The most common side effects of using BIMAT T EYE DROPS are eye redness, burning, itching, stinging, irritation of the conjunctiva, eye pain, dry eye, eye irritation, watery eyes, swollen eyelids, and reduced vision. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: Betafree Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BETAFREE EYE DROPS

BETAFREE EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Brinzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used in adults to manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes). It is typically used in patients who are not responding well to therapy with single agents.

BETAFREE EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of this medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before using BETAFREE EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using BETAFREE EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low or high blood pressure, narrow-angle glaucoma, dry eyes, depression or poor blood circulation in your body as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before using BETAFREE EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using BETAFREE EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, discomfort, irritation, itching or inflammation, blurred vision and bad taste. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of BETAFREE EYE DROPS
Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How BETAFREE EYE DROPS Works

BETAFREE EYE DROPS works by decreasing the production of excessive eye fluids (aqueous humour) while simultaneously increasing their drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use BETAFREE EYE DROPS

Use BETAFREE EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of BETAFREE EYE DROPS into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying BETAFREE EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying BETAFREE EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using BETAFREE EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About AVVA 250MG TABLET

AVVA 250MG TABLET contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with AVVA 250MG TABLET is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as AVVA 250MG TABLET may interfere with these tests.

Before taking AVVA 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

AVVA 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of AVVA 250MG TABLET will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like AVVA 250MG TABLET have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking AVVA 250MG TABLET are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
uses: Abnormal fluid retention in the body
usesDetails:
Uses Of AVVA 250MG TABLET

Manages

Glaucoma
Abnormal fluid retention in the body
Epilepsy
mechanismOfAction:
How AVVA 250MG TABLET Works

AVVA 250MG TABLET effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. AVVA 250MG TABLET also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.
usageDetails:
How to use AVVA 250MG TABLET

Take AVVA 250MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition.

name: Dorsun T Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About DORSUN T EYE DROPS

DORSUN T EYE DROPS is a combination of Dorzolamide and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage increased pressure in the eye caused due to glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with beta-blockers (Ex. timolol) alone.

DORSUN T EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil a few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surfaces to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORSUN T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using DORSUN T EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or previously had any breathing problems, asthma, COPD, diabetes, thyroid problems, Raynaud’s disease or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use DORSUN T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using DORSUN T EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, eye redness and itching, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DORSUN T EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma/ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How DORSUN T EYE DROPS Works

DORSUN T EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of ocular hypertension (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use DORSUN T EYE DROPS

Use DORSUN T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying DORSUN T EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORSUN T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using DORSUN T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION
Controls glaucoma or intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TRUCOM OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

name: Timolet 0.50% Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS

TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS contains Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers. It is used to manage raised pressure in eyes which occurs in various conditions including glaucoma and ocular hypertension. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure inside the eye is higher than normal with no signs of vision loss. Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve and can cause blindness. Symptoms include patchy blind spots, severe headache, eye pain and redness, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision and halos around lights.

Timolol inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, intraocular pressure reduces. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not placed back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory problems like asthma and heart problems. Before using TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have or ever had low blood pressure, problems with blood circulation, thyroid glands, diabetes, or you wear contact lens. TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is only very limited data available on the use of TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS in children. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS are eye irritation, double vision, headache, depression, dizziness, and nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS Works

TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, pressure in the eyes reduces. The exact mechanism of action is not clearly established.
usageDetails:
How to use TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS

Use TIMOLET 0.50% EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not put back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Keep the eyes closed for as long as possible and apply pressure to the corner of the eye. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: BRIMAZE T Ophthalmic Solution 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION
Controls glaucoma or intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BRIMAZE T OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS

BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Brinzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used in adults to manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes). It is typically used in patients who are not responding well to therapy with single agents.

BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of this medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before using BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low or high blood pressure, narrow-angle glaucoma, dry eyes, depression or poor blood circulation in your body as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before using BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS are eye pain, redness, discomfort, irritation, itching or inflammation, blurred vision and bad taste. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS
Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS Works

BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS works by decreasing the production of excessive eye fluids (aqueous humour) while simultaneously increasing their drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS

Use BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using BRINZOLAST EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET

ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET contains Acetazolamide, which belongs to the group of medicines called Carbonic Anhydrase Inhibitors. It is used in the management of glaucoma, retention of fluids in the body, and epilepsy (fits). Glaucoma is a condition of the eyes that can result in loss of vision and blindness by damaging a nerve in the back of the eye called the optic nerve. 

Before starting with the management, your doctor may advise you to undergo some blood tests to check if management with ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET is suitable for you. Tell your doctor if you are due to have any medical tests, as ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET may interfere with these tests.

Before taking ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had severe kidney, liver, or lung problems, chronic non-congestive angle closure glaucoma, reduced function of adrenal glands (Addison’s disease), low sodium/potassium levels, or high chlorine levels in the blood.

ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy and should be taken with consultation of a doctor during breastfeeding. In children and adolescents, the correct dose of ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET will be decided by the doctor, according to the patient’s body weight.

A small number of people being managed with medicines like ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET have had thoughts of harming or killing themselves. If you experience anything like that, immediately contact your doctor. The most common side effects of taking ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET are extreme tiredness, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, and diarrhea. Consult your physician if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET Works

ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET effectively manages glaucoma by blocking an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase that reduces the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye) and lowers the intraocular (eye) pressure. It controls epilepsy (fits) by directly blocking an enzyme in the central nervous system, hence increasing the oxygen level of the body. ACETAZONE 250MG TABLET also acts on certain parts of the kidneys, which increases the excretion of certain substances through urine, which helps in the release of retained fluid in the body and hence relieves fluid retention.

name: Tovaxo T Eye Drops 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TOVAXO T EYE DROPS

TOVAXO T EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Travoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. TOVAXO T EYE DROPS is indicated to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues.  

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

Before using TOVAXO T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any respiratory or heart disease. If you wear soft contact lenses, apply TOVAXO T EYE DROPS at least 15 minutes before you wear your lens.

Do not use this medicine directly on your eyes while wearing your contact lenses in. If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, avoid direct exposure of TOVAXO T EYE DROPS. If any of the medicine encounters with your skin, immediately wash it off with soap and water.  

TOVAXO T EYE DROPS is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers, children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. TOVAXO T EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of using TOVAXO T EYE DROPS are eye redness, pain, itching and eye dryness or discomfort.

It can also lead to a permanent change in the color of the iris or increase the length, thickness, color and/or number of your eyelashes. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

TOVAXO T EYE DROPS effectively reduces elevated pressure in the eye, where timolol acts by decreasing the production of fluid in the eye (aqueous humor) and travoprost acts by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor from the eye. Collectively they decrease the elevated pressure within the eye.

introduction:
Introduction About DORTAS T EYE DROPS

DORTAS T EYE DROPS is a combination of Dorzolamide and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage increased pressure in the eye caused due to glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with beta-blockers (Ex. timolol) alone.

DORTAS T EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil a few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surfaces to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORTAS T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using DORTAS T EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or previously had any breathing problems, asthma, COPD, diabetes, thyroid problems, Raynaud’s disease or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use DORTAS T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using DORTAS T EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, eye redness and itching, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DORTAS T EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma/ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How DORTAS T EYE DROPS Works

DORTAS T EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of ocular hypertension (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use DORTAS T EYE DROPS

Use DORTAS T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying DORTAS T EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORTAS T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using DORTAS T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

name: ABPRESS PF Eye Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS

ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS
Controls glaucoma or intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS Works

ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS

Use ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ABPRESS PF EYE DROPS for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION contains Dorzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthamic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage glaucoma. Glaucoma is group of eye condition that damages the optic nerve (nerves which are responsible for proper vision). It is characterized by increased pressure within the eyes caused due to impaired secretion or drainage of fluids (aqueous humour) within the eyes.

DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION are burning or stinging of eyes, sore eyes, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect bothers you.
uses: Manage glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION
Manage glaucoma (increased pressure within the eye)
mechanismOfAction:
How DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION Works

DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION reduces pressure within the eye. It works by blocking the action of an enzyme called carbonic anhydrase within the eye, that causes the pressure within the eye to raise. As a result, it decreases the elevated pressure within the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of glaucoma (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION

Use DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using DORCARE 2% OPHTHALMIC SOLUTION without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.
