introduction:
Introduction About BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS

BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS
Controls glaucoma or intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS Works

BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS

Use BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BRIMOSOFT T EYE DROPS for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS

OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Travoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS is indicated to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues.  

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

Before using OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any respiratory or heart disease. If you wear soft contact lenses, apply OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS at least 15 minutes before you wear your lens.

Do not use this medicine directly on your eyes while wearing your contact lenses in. If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, avoid direct exposure of OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS. If any of the medicine encounters with your skin, immediately wash it off with soap and water.  

OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers, children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of using OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS are eye redness, pain, itching and eye dryness or discomfort.

It can also lead to a permanent change in the color of the iris or increase the length, thickness, color and/or number of your eyelashes. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.

OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS effectively reduces elevated pressure in the eye, where timolol acts by decreasing the production of fluid in the eye (aqueous humor) and travoprost acts by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor from the eye. Collectively they decrease the elevated pressure within the eye.

OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as heart failure or irregular heartbeat). It should be used with caution among patients who have or had other heart problems such as coronary heart disease or low blood pressure in the past. Consult your doctor before using OPACIA DUO EYE DROPS.

Severe hay fever (an allergic reaction causing itchy eyes, runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing and sinus pressure)
Cloudy eyes

introduction:
Introduction About DORVION T EYE DROPS

DORVION T EYE DROPS is a combination of Dorzolamide and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used to manage increased pressure in the eye caused due to glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used in patients who have not responded adequately to therapy with beta-blockers (Ex. timolol) alone.

DORVION T EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instil a few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surfaces to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORVION T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using DORVION T EYE DROPS inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have or previously had any breathing problems, asthma, COPD, diabetes, thyroid problems, Raynaud’s disease or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or eye surgery) as a precaution.

Do not use DORVION T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using DORVION T EYE DROPS are burning or stinging of eyes, eye redness and itching, blurred vision, bitter taste and headache. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects bothers you.

Manage glaucoma/ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How DORVION T EYE DROPS Works

DORVION T EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes and provides relief from unpleasant symptoms of ocular hypertension (such as eye pain, headache, or blurred vision).
usageDetails:
How to use DORVION T EYE DROPS

Use DORVION T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instil few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying DORVION T EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying DORVION T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using DORVION T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About LATOPROST EYE DROPS

LATOPROST EYE DROPS contains Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs. It is used to manage open angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension (both linked to increased pressure in the eye). Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to the optic nerve (nerves that carry visual messages), that may result in loss of vision. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using LATOPROST EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you or your child have eye problems (pain, irritation or inflammation of eyes, blurred vision or dry eyes) or viral infection of the eye. Also inform your doctor if you have severe asthma, are using contact lens or going to have an eye surgery (cataract surgery).

LATOPROST EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Safety and effectiveness of LATOPROST EYE DROPS in prematurely born infants (less than 36 weeks gestation) has not been established yet. The most common side effects of using LATOPROST EYE DROPS are problems with the eyes like a gradual change in eye colour and eyelashes, redness, irritation, or pain in the eye. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NETALO EYE DROPS

NETALO EYE DROPS contains Netarsudil, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Rho Kinase Inhibitor. NETALO EYE DROPS is indicated for reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

Primary open-angle glaucoma is a type of glaucoma that develops over a period of time due to clogging of drainage channels of the eye. Glaucoma is an irreversible and progressive condition in which the optic nerve gets damaged due to several reasons, such as increased pressure caused by fluid buildup in the front region of the eye. Ocular hypertension can be defined as high intraocular (inside the eye) pressure due to disturbance in balance between production and outflow of aqueous humour (fluid inside the eye).

Inform your doctor before using NETALO EYE DROPS if you have trauma to the eye, planned eye surgery, dry eyes, concurrent eye disease, or if you have ocular epithelial surface disruption, as the risk of bacterial keratitis (bacterial infection of the outer layer of the eye) is increased in such cases.

NETALO EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using. NETALO EYE DROPS should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

NETALO EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you wear contact lenses, they should be removed prior to instillation of this medicine and can be reinserted 15 minutes following its administration.

NETALO EYE DROPS may cause some side effects such as conjunctival hyperaemia (dilation of vessels of conjunctiva due to inflammation), corneal verticillate (condition in which corneal deposits form a faint golden-brown whorl pattern), conjunctival haemorrhage, instillation site pain, and erythema. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NETALO EYE DROPS Works

NETALO EYE DROPS is a rho kinase inhibitor that works by reducing intraocular pressure (IOP) by increasing the outflow of aqueous humour (transparent fluid in the eye, which is important for maintaining pressure inside the eye and nourishment of our natural lens) through relaxation of the trabecular meshwork.
usageDetails:
How to use NETALO EYE DROPS

Instil NETALO EYE DROPS into the affected eye as directed by your doctor. NETALO EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Do not inject or swallow the medicine. Wash your hands before using and avoid touching the nozzle or dropper while using the medicine, as it may contaminate the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration according to your disease condition, body weight, and age. The tip of the dispensing container should avoid contacting the eye, surrounding structures, fingers, or any other surface to avoid contamination of the solution.

name: SENTIBRIM BZ Ophthalmic Suspension 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is a combination of Brimonidine and Brinzolamide which belongs to the group of medicines called Ophthalmic anti-glaucoma agents. It is used in adults to manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma (increased pressure within the eyes). It is typically used in patients who are not responding well to therapy with single agents.

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is for ophthalmic use only. Instil few drops of this medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low or high blood pressure, narrow-angle glaucoma, dry eyes, depression or poor blood circulation in your body as a precaution.

Consult your doctor before using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION are eye pain, redness, discomfort, irritation, itching or inflammation, blurred vision and bad taste. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION
Manage ocular hypertension and glaucoma in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION Works

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION works by decreasing the production of excessive eye fluids (aqueous humour) while simultaneously increasing their drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION

Use SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as advised by your doctor. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or with other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

Therefore, consult your doctor before using it. Women of childbearing age should use proper contraceptive method to avoid pregnancy while undergoing therapy with SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.
SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, drowsiness or tiredness after using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION.
Avoid the consumption of alcohol while using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION as it may increase the risk of side effects.
SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.
Talk to your doctor if you are allergic to Brimonidine, Brinzolamide, sulphonamides (such as glipizide, gliclazide) or diuretics (such as furosemide).
SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as coronary heart disease or heart failure). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is not recommended for use if you:

Have hyperchloremic acidosis (a condition where there is too much of acidity in blood)

Before using SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you:

Have dry eyes or problems in your cornea
Have narrow angle glaucoma (a type of rapid increase in pressure within the eye)
Have high or low blood pressure
Have depression
Have poor blood circulation in the body (such as Raynaud’s disease)
Have reduced blood supply to the brain or reduced mental capacity
Wear soft contact lenses

Use in pediatrics:

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Use in geriatrics:

SENTIBRIM BZ OPHTHALMIC SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

introduction:
Introduction About LACOMA PF EYE DROPS

LACOMA PF EYE DROPS contains Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs. It is used to manage open angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension (both linked to increased pressure in the eye). Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to the optic nerve (nerves that carry visual messages), that may result in loss of vision. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using LACOMA PF EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you or your child have eye problems (pain, irritation or inflammation of eyes, blurred vision or dry eyes) or viral infection of the eye. Also inform your doctor if you have severe asthma, are using contact lens or going to have an eye surgery (cataract surgery).

LACOMA PF EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Safety and effectiveness of LACOMA PF EYE DROPS in prematurely born infants (less than 36 weeks gestation) has not been established yet. The most common side effects of using LACOMA PF EYE DROPS are problems with the eyes like a gradual change in eye colour and eyelashes, redness, irritation, or pain in the eye. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
usesDetails:
Uses Of LACOMA PF EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
mechanismOfAction:
How LACOMA PF EYE DROPS Works

LACOMA PF EYE DROPS works by increasing the natural discharge of fluid (that nourishes the eye) from inside the eye into the bloodstream. Hence decreasing the pressure in the eye.
usageDetails:
How to use LACOMA PF EYE DROPS

Use LACOMA PF EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before using LACOMA PF EYE DROPS. Use a finger to gently pull down the lower eyelid to make a pocket of the affected eye. Place one drop into the affected eye(s) and then release the lower eyelid and hold for 1 minute whilst keeping the eye closed.

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using the eye drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting them back. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Latocom Eye Drops 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About LATOCOM EYE DROPS

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. It is used to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used only when other medicines have not worked appropriately.

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying LATOCOM EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using LATOCOM EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have asthma, COPD or any respiratory problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, low blood pressure, dry eyes or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or inflammations) or if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery as a precaution.

Do not use LATOCOM EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using LATOCOM EYE DROPS are change in lens color, eye pain, redness or irritation, eye discomfort and mild burning sensation following application. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LATOCOM EYE DROPS

It is used in adults with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension:

To reduce intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How LATOCOM EYE DROPS Works

LATOCOM EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye while simultaneously improving its drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use LATOCOM EYE DROPS

Use LATOCOM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying LATOCOM EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying LATOCOM EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using LATOCOM EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

warnings.details: LATOCOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary by their physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using it.
LATOCOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it could pass through the breast milk. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your vision becomes blur after using LATOCOM EYE DROPS.
Do not use LATOCOM EYE DROPS if you are allergic to Timolol, Latanoprost or to other beta-blockers (Ex. betaxolol, levobunolol) or prostaglandin analogs (Ex. bimatoprost).

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who currently have or previously had any lung problems such as asthma or COPD. It should be used with caution in patients with breathing difficulties. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems (such as slow or irregular heartbeat or heart failure). It should be used with caution among patients who have or had other heart problems (such as coronary artery disease, angina) in the past. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

Before using LATOCOM EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure
Have Raynaud’s disease (poor blood circulation to hands and feet)
Have diabetes
Have an overactivity of thyroid gland
Have muscle weakness
Cataract surgery or any upcoming surgery
Have dry eyes or problems in your cornea
Any other eye problems (such as eye pain, irritation, inflammation or blurred vision)\
Wear soft contact lenses
Have an allergic reaction
Have a viral infection in the eye

Use in Pediatrics:

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Use in Geriatrics:

LATOCOM EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, consult your doctor before using it.

name: BROMOSTAR T Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS

BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS is a combination of Brimonidine and Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called an Alpha-adrenergic receptor agonist and Beta-adrenergic receptor inhibitors respectively. BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS is used to reduce the elevated intraocular pressure (pressure inside the eye) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately managed intraocular pressure.

Glaucoma is a disease which damages the optic nerve (nerve in the back of eye) because of excessive pressure inside the eye and may gradually lead to blindness. Ocular hypertension is a condition when pressure inside the eye rises higher than normal. Such conditions are characterized by halos, pain and blurred vision.

BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with reactive airway disease such as bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis and other severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (group of lung diseases causing difficulty in breathing).

It is also not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases such as sinus bradycardia (a type of slow heartbeat), 2nd or 3rd degree heart block, heart failure or cardiogenic shock. BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS should be used with caution in patients with liver and kidney problems.

BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS should be used in pregnant women only if clearly advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women and children or adolescents (aged below 17 years).

The common side effects associated with the use of are BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS are eye redness, eye burning, stinging or pain in eyes, small breaks on the eye surface, inflammation in the eyelids and itching in eyes. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS
Controls glaucoma or intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS Works

BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS helps to lower eye pressure due to glaucoma and intraocular hypertension, where Brimonidine works by allowing better fluid drainage from the eye resulting in reduced pressure in the eye and Timolol works by decreasing the amount of fluid formed in the eye which results in reduced intraocular pressure in the eye thereby managing glaucoma and ocular hypertension.
usageDetails:
How to use BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS

Use BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before application, tilt your head back slightly and gently pull down the lower eyelid until there is a small pocket. Turn the bottle upside down and squeeze it to release one drop into each eye that needs management. Release the lower lid and close your eye. Keep the eye closed and press your finger against the corner of your eye for two minutes. If you miss a drop, try again.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BROMOSTAR T EYE DROPS for you depending upon your age and severity of the condition.

introduction:
Introduction About LACOMA T EYE DROPS

LACOMA T EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. It is used to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used only when other medicines have not worked appropriately.

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

LACOMA T EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying LACOMA T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using LACOMA T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have asthma, COPD or any respiratory problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, low blood pressure, dry eyes or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or inflammations) or if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery as a precaution.

Do not use LACOMA T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using LACOMA T EYE DROPS are change in lens color, eye pain, redness or irritation, eye discomfort and mild burning sensation following application. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of LACOMA T EYE DROPS

It is used in adults with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension:

To reduce intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How LACOMA T EYE DROPS Works

LACOMA T EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye while simultaneously improving its drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use LACOMA T EYE DROPS

Use LACOMA T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying LACOMA T EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying LACOMA T EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using LACOMA T EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About PILOMAX 5MG TABLET

PILOMAX 5MG TABLET contains Pilocarpine which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agonists. It is used to manage xerostomia (dry mouth) in patients receiving radiotherapy for cancer of the head or neck.

PILOMAX 5MG TABLET can also be used to manage dryness of mouth or eyes in patients with Sjögren’s syndrome (an auto-immune disease affecting the tear or salivary gland). Your doctor will regularly check your eyes before and during management with pilocarpine, particularly if you have had any eye disorders.

PILOMAX 5MG TABLET may cause excessive sweating. So, try to take more fluids such as water or juices. If it does not help and if you feel more dehydrated contact your doctor immediately. PILOMAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having kidney, lung or heart problems or any eye inflammation.

Before taking PILOMAX 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any bile duct, gall bladder, stomach, intestinal, cognitive or eye problems. PILOMAX 5MG TABLET should not be used in pregnancy unless recommended by your doctor. Your doctor will tell you whether you should stop taking PILOMAX 5MG TABLET or breast-feeding.

PILOMAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). The most common side effects of taking PILOMAX 5MG TABLET are flu-like symptoms, sweating, headache and increased urge to urinate, weakness, chills, etc. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms bother you.

How PILOMAX 5MG TABLET Works

PILOMAX 5MG TABLET makes your body produce more saliva, tears, sweat, gastric juices and mucus by stimulating certain nerves and glands in your body.

Correct dose and duration will be decided by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking PILOMAX 5MG TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: RAIKI Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About RAIKI EYE DROPS

RAIKI EYE DROPS contains Netarsudil, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Rho Kinase Inhibitor. RAIKI EYE DROPS is indicated for reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

Primary open-angle glaucoma is a type of glaucoma that develops over a period of time due to clogging of drainage channels of the eye. Glaucoma is an irreversible and progressive condition in which the optic nerve gets damaged due to several reasons, such as increased pressure caused by fluid buildup in the front region of the eye. Ocular hypertension can be defined as high intraocular (inside the eye) pressure due to disturbance in balance between production and outflow of aqueous humour (fluid inside the eye).

Inform your doctor before using RAIKI EYE DROPS if you have trauma to the eye, planned eye surgery, dry eyes, concurrent eye disease, or if you have ocular epithelial surface disruption, as the risk of bacterial keratitis (bacterial infection of the outer layer of the eye) is increased in such cases.

RAIKI EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using. RAIKI EYE DROPS should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

RAIKI EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you wear contact lenses, they should be removed prior to instillation of this medicine and can be reinserted 15 minutes following its administration.

RAIKI EYE DROPS may cause some side effects such as conjunctival hyperaemia (dilation of vessels of conjunctiva due to inflammation), corneal verticillate (condition in which corneal deposits form a faint golden-brown whorl pattern), conjunctival haemorrhage, instillation site pain, and erythema. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to reduce elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of RAIKI EYE DROPS
Used to reduce elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How RAIKI EYE DROPS Works

RAIKI EYE DROPS is a rho kinase inhibitor that works by reducing intraocular pressure (IOP) by increasing the outflow of aqueous humour (transparent fluid in the eye, which is important for maintaining pressure inside the eye and nourishment of our natural lens) through relaxation of the trabecular meshwork.
usageDetails:
How to use RAIKI EYE DROPS

Instil RAIKI EYE DROPS into the affected eye as directed by your doctor. RAIKI EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Do not inject or swallow the medicine. Wash your hands before using and avoid touching the nozzle or dropper while using the medicine, as it may contaminate the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration according to your disease condition, body weight, and age. The tip of the dispensing container should avoid contacting the eye, surrounding structures, fingers, or any other surface to avoid contamination of the solution.

introduction:
Introduction About 9 PM EYE DROPS

9 PM EYE DROPS contains Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs. It is used to manage open angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension (both linked to increased pressure in the eye). Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to the optic nerve (nerves that carry visual messages), that may result in loss of vision. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using 9 PM EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you or your child have eye problems (pain, irritation or inflammation of eyes, blurred vision or dry eyes) or viral infection of the eye. Also inform your doctor if you have severe asthma, are using contact lens or going to have an eye surgery (cataract surgery).

9 PM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Safety and effectiveness of 9 PM EYE DROPS in prematurely born infants (less than 36 weeks gestation) has not been established yet. The most common side effects of using 9 PM EYE DROPS are problems with the eyes like a gradual change in eye colour and eyelashes, redness, irritation, or pain in the eye. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
usesDetails:
Uses Of 9 PM EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
mechanismOfAction:
How 9 PM EYE DROPS Works

9 PM EYE DROPS works by increasing the natural discharge of fluid (that nourishes the eye) from inside the eye into the bloodstream. Hence decreasing the pressure in the eye.
usageDetails:
How to use 9 PM EYE DROPS

Use 9 PM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before using 9 PM EYE DROPS. Use a finger to gently pull down the lower eyelid to make a pocket of the affected eye. Place one drop into the affected eye(s) and then release the lower eyelid and hold for 1 minute whilst keeping the eye closed.

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using the eye drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting them back. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TIMOLET OD Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS

TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS contains Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers. It is used to manage raised pressure in eyes which occurs in various conditions including glaucoma and ocular hypertension. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure inside the eye is higher than normal with no signs of vision loss. Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve and can cause blindness. Symptoms include patchy blind spots, severe headache, eye pain and redness, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision and halos around lights.

Timolol inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, intraocular pressure reduces. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not placed back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory problems like asthma and heart problems. Before using TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have or ever had low blood pressure, problems with blood circulation, thyroid glands, diabetes, or you wear contact lens. TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is only very limited data available on the use of TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS in children. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS are eye irritation, double vision, headache, depression, dizziness, and nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

How TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS Works

TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, pressure in the eyes reduces. The exact mechanism of action is not clearly established.
usageDetails:
How to use TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS

Use TIMOLET OD EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not put back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Keep the eyes closed for as long as possible and apply pressure to the corner of the eye. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Xalatan Eye Drops 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About XALATAN EYE DROPS

XALATAN EYE DROPS contains Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Prostaglandin analogs. It is used to manage open angle glaucoma and ocular hypertension (both linked to increased pressure in the eye). Glaucoma is a group of diseases characterized by gradual damage to the optic nerve (nerves that carry visual messages), that may result in loss of vision. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using XALATAN EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you or your child have eye problems (pain, irritation or inflammation of eyes, blurred vision or dry eyes) or viral infection of the eye. Also inform your doctor if you have severe asthma, are using contact lens or going to have an eye surgery (cataract surgery).

XALATAN EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Safety and effectiveness of XALATAN EYE DROPS in prematurely born infants (less than 36 weeks gestation) has not been established yet. The most common side effects of using XALATAN EYE DROPS are problems with the eyes like a gradual change in eye colour and eyelashes, redness, irritation, or pain in the eye. Inform your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
usesDetails:
Uses Of XALATAN EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and hypertension of the eye
mechanismOfAction:
How XALATAN EYE DROPS Works

XALATAN EYE DROPS works by increasing the natural discharge of fluid (that nourishes the eye) from inside the eye into the bloodstream. Hence decreasing the pressure in the eye.
usageDetails:
How to use XALATAN EYE DROPS

Use XALATAN EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before using XALATAN EYE DROPS. Use a finger to gently pull down the lower eyelid to make a pocket of the affected eye. Place one drop into the affected eye(s) and then release the lower eyelid and hold for 1 minute whilst keeping the eye closed.

If you wear contact lenses, remove them before using the eye drops and wait at least 15 minutes before putting them back. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: BRIMTOFAST Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS

BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS contains Bimatoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-glaucoma preparations. It is used to manage glaucoma. Glaucoma is group of eye condition that damages the optic nerve (nerves which are responsible for proper vision). It is characterized by increased pressure within the eyes. It is caused due to impaired secretion or drainage of fluids (aqueous humour) within the eyes.

Bimatoprost improves the drainage of the accumulated fluids (aqueous humour) from the eye. As a result, it helps in reducing the elevated pressure within the eye. Prior to the management, your doctor would take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you had undergone any surgery in your eyes (such as cataract) as a precaution. You must also inform your doctor if you have infections in your eye or any underlying heart conditions (such as low blood pressure or low heart rate).

During management with BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS, you may experience certain changes in your eye such as sunken eyes, eyelid drooping, skin tightening around the eyes, sudden growth in eyelashes or darkness around the eyes or in the iris. These side effects are usually temporary and disappears once therapy is stopped.

Consult your doctor before using BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS is usually not prescribed in children and adolescents (below 18 years.
uses: Manage glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
usesDetails:
Uses Of BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
mechanismOfAction:
How BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS Works

BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS effectively reduces pressure within the eyes, where bimatoprost acts by increasing the drainage of the fluids (aqueous humour) accumulated within the eye. This reduces strain on the eyes and therefore reduces the elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS

Use BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using BRIMTOFAST EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

name: Xalacom Eye Drops 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About XALACOM EYE DROPS

XALACOM EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Latanoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. It is used to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension. It is typically used only when other medicines have not worked appropriately.

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

XALACOM EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying XALACOM EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using XALACOM EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have asthma, COPD or any respiratory problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any heart problems, diabetes, thyroid problems, low blood pressure, dry eyes or any other eye problems apart from glaucoma (such as eye infections or inflammations) or if you are scheduled for any upcoming surgery as a precaution.

Do not use XALACOM EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using XALACOM EYE DROPS are change in lens color, eye pain, redness or irritation, eye discomfort and mild burning sensation following application. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect bothers you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of XALACOM EYE DROPS

It is used in adults with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension:

To reduce intraocular pressure
mechanismOfAction:
How XALACOM EYE DROPS Works

XALACOM EYE DROPS reduces intraocular pressure by decreasing the production of aqueous humour (a type of lubricating eye fluid) in the eye while simultaneously improving its drainage. As a result, it reduces strain on the eyes which therefore reduces elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use XALACOM EYE DROPS

Use XALACOM EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before and after application. Tilt your head slightly and gently pull the lower eyelid downwards.

Instill few drops of the medicine into the affected eye(s). Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute. Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination.

Apply applying XALACOM EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying XALACOM EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon the severity of the disease condition. Do not stop using XALACOM EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

warnings.details: XALACOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary by their physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using it.
XALACOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it could pass through the breast milk. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using it.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if your vision becomes blur after using XALACOM EYE DROPS.
Do not use XALACOM EYE DROPS if you are allergic to Timolol, Latanoprost or to other beta-blockers (Ex. betaxolol, levobunolol) or prostaglandin analogs (Ex. bimatoprost).

XALACOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who currently have or previously had any lung problems such as asthma or COPD. It should be used with caution in patients with breathing difficulties. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

XALACOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with heart problems (such as slow or irregular heartbeat or heart failure). It should be used with caution among patients who have or had other heart problems (such as coronary artery disease, angina) in the past. Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Others

Before using XALACOM EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure
Have Raynaud’s disease (poor blood circulation to hands and feet)
Have diabetes
Have an overactivity of thyroid gland
Have muscle weakness
Cataract surgery or any upcoming surgery
Have dry eyes or problems in your cornea
Any other eye problems (such as eye pain, irritation, inflammation or blurred vision)\
Wear soft contact lenses
Have an allergic reaction
Have a viral infection in the eye

Use in Pediatrics:

XALACOM EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before using it.

Use in Geriatrics:

XALACOM EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, consult your doctor before using it.

name: TRAVOTAS T Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is a combination of Timolol and Travoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers and Prostaglandin analogs respectively. TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is indicated to decrease the elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues.  

Ocular hypertension is an eye condition in which the pressure within the eye exceeds the normal range (above 16mmHg). Open-angle glaucoma is a chronic, progressive eye condition primarily caused due to elevated intraocular pressure (pressure in the eyes). It can lead to permanent loss of vision if not managed properly. Symptoms include intense eye pain or tenderness, blurred vision, eye redness or itching and headache.

Before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any respiratory or heart disease. If you wear soft contact lenses, apply TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS at least 15 minutes before you wear your lens.

Do not use this medicine directly on your eyes while wearing your contact lenses in. If you are pregnant or trying to become pregnant, avoid direct exposure of TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS. If any of the medicine encounters with your skin, immediately wash it off with soap and water.  

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding mothers, children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above).

The most common side effects of using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS are eye redness, pain, itching and eye dryness or discomfort.

It can also lead to a permanent change in the color of the iris or increase the length, thickness, color and/or number of your eyelashes. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects bothers you.
uses: To decrease elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension (who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues)
usesDetails:

To decrease elevated pressure in the eye among adult patients with open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension (who are insufficiently responsive to topical beta blockers or prostaglandin analogues)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS Works

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS effectively reduces elevated pressure in the eye, where timolol acts by decreasing the production of fluid in the eye (aqueous humor) and travoprost acts by increasing the drainage of aqueous humor from the eye. Collectively they decrease the elevated pressure within the eye.

usageDetails:
How to use TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS

Use TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Instill the prescribed amount of the medicine into your eye(s). Follow the following steps while using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS: 

Wash your hands thoroughly before application
Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull down your lower eyelid
Gently squeeze the bottle and instill the medicine drop wise into your eye
Close your eyes and gently press the corner of your eye with a finger for 2 minutes to avoid leakage of the medicine from your eye
If necessary, repeat the same steps for the other eye
Close the bottle and wash your hands

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your fingertips, eyelids or other parts of the eye surface to avoid the risk of contamination. Do not use TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS for more than 4 weeks after opening it to manage infections. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your condition. Continue to use TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS, if your doctor tells you to do so, to obtain better results.

warnings.details: TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women or among women who are trying to become pregnant unless clearly necessary. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before using this medicine. Women of child-bearing potential should use a suitable contraceptive method to avoid getting pregnant while using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.
TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it could pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.
Do not drive or operate any heavy tools or machines if you experience blurred vision, dizziness, hallucination, nervousness or fatigue after using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.
Do not use TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS if you are allergic to Timolol, Travoprost or other beta-blockers (Ex. betaxolol, levobunolol) or prostaglandin analogs (Ex. latanoprost, bimatoprost).

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients who have or had any respiratory problems (such as asthma, severe chronic obstructive bronchitis or other breathing problems) in the past. Consult your doctor before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as heart failure or irregular heartbeat). It should be used with caution among patients who have or had other heart problems such as coronary heart disease or low blood pressure in the past. Consult your doctor before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.

Others

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for you, if you have:

Severe hay fever (an allergic reaction causing itchy eyes, runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing and sinus pressure)
Cloudy eyes

Before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have:

Blood circulation disorders (such as Raynaud’s disease or Raynaud’s syndrome)
Diabetes
Overactivity of the thyroid gland
Myasthenia gravis (long-term neuromuscular weakness)
Cataract surgery or any upcoming surgery
An eye inflammation

Use in pediatrics:

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety and effectiveness. Consult your doctor before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.

Use in geriatrics:

TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS is considered safe for use in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). However, consult your doctor before using TRAVOTAS T EYE DROPS.

name: Intaprost Eye Drops 3ml
introduction:
Introduction About INTAPROST EYE DROPS

INTAPROST EYE DROPS contains Bimatoprost which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-glaucoma preparations. It is used to manage glaucoma. Glaucoma is group of eye condition that damages the optic nerve (nerves which are responsible for proper vision). It is characterized by increased pressure within the eyes. It is caused due to impaired secretion or drainage of fluids (aqueous humour) within the eyes.

Bimatoprost improves the drainage of the accumulated fluids (aqueous humour) from the eye. As a result, it helps in reducing the elevated pressure within the eye. Prior to the management, your doctor would take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

Before using INTAPROST EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you had undergone any surgery in your eyes (such as cataract) as a precaution. You must also inform your doctor if you have infections in your eye or any underlying heart conditions (such as low blood pressure or low heart rate).

During management with INTAPROST EYE DROPS, you may experience certain changes in your eye such as sunken eyes, eyelid drooping, skin tightening around the eyes, sudden growth in eyelashes or darkness around the eyes or in the iris. These side effects are usually temporary and disappears once therapy is stopped.

Consult your doctor before using INTAPROST EYE DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution. INTAPROST EYE DROPS is usually not prescribed in children and adolescents (below 18 years.

Manage glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
mechanismOfAction:
How INTAPROST EYE DROPS Works

INTAPROST EYE DROPS effectively reduces pressure within the eyes, where bimatoprost acts by increasing the drainage of the fluids (aqueous humour) accumulated within the eye. This reduces strain on the eyes and therefore reduces the elevated intraocular pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use INTAPROST EYE DROPS

Use INTAPROST EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands before use. Instil few drops of INTAPROST EYE DROPS into the affected eye. Close your eyes and press the corner of your eye with your finger for a minute.

Do not touch the tip of the dropper with your eye or other body surface to avoid contamination. Apply applying INTAPROST EYE DROPS, leave a time gap of at least 5 minutes before applying other eye drops or ointment. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying INTAPROST EYE DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop using INTAPROST EYE DROPS without consulting your doctor, as the pressure within the eye may raise once again.

introduction:
Introduction About CARPINE EYE DROPS

CARPINE EYE DROPS contains Pilocarpine which belongs to the group of medicines called Cholinergic agonists. It is used to manage certain types of glaucoma (a rise in the pressure within the eye) and to reverse the effect of medicines that cause the pupil of the eye to enlarge.

Your doctor will ask you to remove your contact lenses prior to the administration of CARPINE EYE DROPS and will regularly check your eyes before and during management, particularly if you have had any eye disorders.

CARPINE EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having some particular eye conditions where you can't let the pupil of the eye to constrict (Ex. inflammation of the iris, some types of glaucoma) or if you wear soft contact lenses. Before using CARPINE EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have any heart, lung, kidney, stomach or eye problems.

CARPINE EYE DROPS should be used with caution in pregnant and breast feeding women. In children, the doctor will prescribe the right dose of CARPINE EYE DROPS depending on how they respond to management.

The most common side effects of CARPINE EYE DROPS are eye itching, paining, burning, swollen eyelid, temporary blurred vision, headache, etc. See your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARPINE EYE DROPS Works

CARPINE EYE DROPS affects the eye muscles causing the pupil of the eye to get smaller. It also reduces the pressure within the eyeball by decreasing the production of aqueous humor (fluid in the eye).
usageDetails:
How to use CARPINE EYE DROPS

Always use CARPINE EYE DROPS as directed by your physician. It is for ophthalmic use only. Wash your hands thoroughly. Pull your lower eyelid slowly and instill one or two drops of CARPINE EYE DROPS inside the lower eyelid. Close your eyes and gently press on the inner corner of your eyelid for 1 minute to manage the drainage of the solution into your nose and throat.

If needed, repeat the same for the other eye. Correct dose and duration will be determined by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop using CARPINE EYE DROPS unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: Timanol 0.5% Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS

TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS contains Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers. It is used to manage raised pressure in eyes which occurs in various conditions including glaucoma and ocular hypertension. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure inside the eye is higher than normal with no signs of vision loss. Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve and can cause blindness. Symptoms include patchy blind spots, severe headache, eye pain and redness, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision and halos around lights.

Timolol inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, intraocular pressure reduces. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not placed back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory problems like asthma and heart problems. Before using TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have or ever had low blood pressure, problems with blood circulation, thyroid glands, diabetes, or you wear contact lens. TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is only very limited data available on the use of TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS in children. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS are eye irritation, double vision, headache, depression, dizziness, and nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS Works

TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, pressure in the eyes reduces. The exact mechanism of action is not clearly established.
usageDetails:
How to use TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS

Use TIMANOL 0.5% EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not put back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Keep the eyes closed for as long as possible and apply pressure to the corner of the eye. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: OPTIPRES Eye Drops 2.5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OPTIPRES EYE DROPS

OPTIPRES EYE DROPS contains Netarsudil, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Rho Kinase Inhibitor. OPTIPRES EYE DROPS is indicated for reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

Primary open-angle glaucoma is a type of glaucoma that develops over a period of time due to clogging of drainage channels of the eye. Glaucoma is an irreversible and progressive condition in which the optic nerve gets damaged due to several reasons, such as increased pressure caused by fluid buildup in the front region of the eye. Ocular hypertension can be defined as high intraocular (inside the eye) pressure due to disturbance in balance between production and outflow of aqueous humour (fluid inside the eye).

Inform your doctor before using OPTIPRES EYE DROPS if you have trauma to the eye, planned eye surgery, dry eyes, concurrent eye disease, or if you have ocular epithelial surface disruption, as the risk of bacterial keratitis (bacterial infection of the outer layer of the eye) is increased in such cases.

OPTIPRES EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using. OPTIPRES EYE DROPS should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

OPTIPRES EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you wear contact lenses, they should be removed prior to instillation of this medicine and can be reinserted 15 minutes following its administration.

OPTIPRES EYE DROPS may cause some side effects such as conjunctival hyperaemia (dilation of vessels of conjunctiva due to inflammation), corneal verticillate (condition in which corneal deposits form a faint golden-brown whorl pattern), conjunctival haemorrhage, instillation site pain, and erythema. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the above side effects worsen.

Used to reduce elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How OPTIPRES EYE DROPS Works

OPTIPRES EYE DROPS is a rho kinase inhibitor that works by reducing intraocular pressure (IOP) by increasing the outflow of aqueous humour (transparent fluid in the eye, which is important for maintaining pressure inside the eye and nourishment of our natural lens) through relaxation of the trabecular meshwork.
usageDetails:
How to use OPTIPRES EYE DROPS

Instil OPTIPRES EYE DROPS into the affected eye as directed by your doctor. OPTIPRES EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Do not inject or swallow the medicine. Wash your hands before using and avoid touching the nozzle or dropper while using the medicine, as it may contaminate the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration according to your disease condition, body weight, and age. The tip of the dispensing container should avoid contacting the eye, surrounding structures, fingers, or any other surface to avoid contamination of the solution.

introduction:
Introduction About NETASUDIL EYE DROPS

NETASUDIL EYE DROPS contains Netarsudil, which belongs to the group of medicines known as Rho Kinase Inhibitor. NETASUDIL EYE DROPS is indicated for reduction of elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension.

Primary open-angle glaucoma is a type of glaucoma that develops over a period of time due to clogging of drainage channels of the eye. Glaucoma is an irreversible and progressive condition in which the optic nerve gets damaged due to several reasons, such as increased pressure caused by fluid buildup in the front region of the eye. Ocular hypertension can be defined as high intraocular (inside the eye) pressure due to disturbance in balance between production and outflow of aqueous humour (fluid inside the eye).

Inform your doctor before using NETASUDIL EYE DROPS if you have trauma to the eye, planned eye surgery, dry eyes, concurrent eye disease, or if you have ocular epithelial surface disruption, as the risk of bacterial keratitis (bacterial infection of the outer layer of the eye) is increased in such cases.

NETASUDIL EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using. NETASUDIL EYE DROPS should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before using it.

NETASUDIL EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age. Consult your doctor before using it.

If you wear contact lenses, they should be removed prior to instillation of this medicine and can be reinserted 15 minutes following its administration.

NETASUDIL EYE DROPS may cause some side effects such as conjunctival hyperaemia (dilation of vessels of conjunctiva due to inflammation), corneal verticillate (condition in which corneal deposits form a faint golden-brown whorl pattern), conjunctival haemorrhage, instillation site pain, and erythema. Consult your doctor immediately in case any of the above side effects worsen.
uses: Used to reduce elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of NETASUDIL EYE DROPS
Used to reduce elevated intraocular pressure in adult patients with primary open-angle glaucoma or ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How NETASUDIL EYE DROPS Works

NETASUDIL EYE DROPS is a rho kinase inhibitor that works by reducing intraocular pressure (IOP) by increasing the outflow of aqueous humour (transparent fluid in the eye, which is important for maintaining pressure inside the eye and nourishment of our natural lens) through relaxation of the trabecular meshwork.
usageDetails:
How to use NETASUDIL EYE DROPS

Instil NETASUDIL EYE DROPS into the affected eye as directed by your doctor. NETASUDIL EYE DROPS is for ophthalmic use only. Do not inject or swallow the medicine. Wash your hands before using and avoid touching the nozzle or dropper while using the medicine, as it may contaminate the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration according to your disease condition, body weight, and age. The tip of the dispensing container should avoid contacting the eye, surrounding structures, fingers, or any other surface to avoid contamination of the solution.

name: SENSOLOL Eye Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About SENSOLOL EYE DROPS

SENSOLOL EYE DROPS contains Timolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Beta-blockers. It is used to manage raised pressure in eyes which occurs in various conditions including glaucoma and ocular hypertension. Ocular hypertension is when the pressure inside the eye is higher than normal with no signs of vision loss. Glaucoma is a group of eye conditions that damage the optic nerve and can cause blindness. Symptoms include patchy blind spots, severe headache, eye pain and redness, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision and halos around lights.

Timolol inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, intraocular pressure reduces. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not placed back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Prior to the management, your doctor may want you to take certain eye tests to understand your existing condition.

SENSOLOL EYE DROPS is not recommended for use in patients having respiratory problems like asthma and heart problems. Before using SENSOLOL EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you have or ever had low blood pressure, problems with blood circulation, thyroid glands, diabetes, or you wear contact lens. SENSOLOL EYE DROPS is generally not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. There is only very limited data available on the use of SENSOLOL EYE DROPS in children. Consult your doctor before using. The most common side effects of using SENSOLOL EYE DROPS are eye irritation, double vision, headache, depression, dizziness, and nausea. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Uses Of SENSOLOL EYE DROPS
Manage glaucoma and ocular hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How SENSOLOL EYE DROPS Works

SENSOLOL EYE DROPS inhibits binding of certain receptors (beta receptors) on the tissues lining the inner wall of eyeball. These tissues increase the production of aqueous humor (fluid of the eye). So, by inhibiting beta receptors, there is a reduction in aqueous humor production and therefore, pressure in the eyes reduces. The exact mechanism of action is not clearly established.
usageDetails:
How to use SENSOLOL EYE DROPS

Use SENSOLOL EYE DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. It is important that your soft contact lenses are removed before using this medicine and not put back into your eyes for at least 15 minutes. Tilt your head back and pull down your lower eyelid. Make sure you wash your hands and do not touch any surface while using it. Keep the eyes closed for as long as possible and apply pressure to the corner of the eye. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not use SENSOLOL EYE DROPS if you are allergic to Timolol.

SENSOLOL EYE DROPS is not recommended for patients with a slow heartbeat, heart problems, heart failure, disorders of heart rhythm or with an episode of cardiogenic shock. It should be used with caution in patients with coronary heart disease (chest pain or tightness, breathlessness or choking), low blood pressure, poor blood circulation disease (such as Raynaud's disease or Raynaud's syndrome). Consult your doctor before using SENSOLOL EYE DROPS.
There is only limited data available on the use of SENSOLOL EYE DROPS in newborns, infants, and younger children. Consult your doctor before using.

Others

Have diabetes
Have poor blood circulation disease (such as Raynaud's disease or Raynaud's syndrome)
Overactivity of the thyroid gland
Have to undergo a surgery as it may change effects of some medicines used during anesthesia

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before using SENSOLOL EYE DROPS, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Medicines used to manage diabetes. (Ex. metformin, glimepiride)
A calcium antagonist (Ex.  nifedipine, verapamil or diltiazem), catecholamine-depleting agents (Ex. rauwolfia alkaloids/reserpine), clonidine to manage high blood pressure
Digoxin (to manage heart failure or an abnormal heartbeat)
Pressor amines (Ex. adrenaline) to manage allergic reaction
Quinidine (to manage heart conditions and some types of malaria)
Other beta-blockers taken by mouth or used as eye drops
Antidepressants (Ex. fluoxetine and paroxetine)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally use too much of SENSOLOL EYE DROPS, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose of SENSOLOL EYE DROPS are headache, light-headedness, difficulty in breathing, chest pain, feeling that your heart rate has slowed down.
